_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: window.dropFiles(files) drops files on the composer: it dispatches a "drop" DragEvent carrying a text/plain File for each [name, content] pair on ".message-input-container"; call it in an eval, e.g. window.dropFiles([["a.txt", "some content"]]). A dropped file shows as an attachment chip, not as text. 1. Navigate to /new and wait for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Drop one file, "test-drop.txt" containing "test content". 3. There should be exactly one attachment chip (".message-attachment"). 4. The message input must still be empty: eval JSON.stringify of its value, which should be exactly "" (two double-quote characters; an empty expectation would check nothing).
